name: URL DNS and ASN Expansion
description: Resolve a URL into IPv4/IPv6 TCP endpoints and IPv4 origin ASNs, linked to the original URL attribute.
requirements: DNS access to a recursive resolver, including Team Cymru TXT records
features: Resolve all A and AAAA records with the system resolver or an optional nameserver; deduplicate addresses.
Create one standard ip-port object per address with ip, dst-port, protocol=tcp and hostname when the URL uses a hostname.
An explicit port overrides scheme defaults. HTTP defaults to 80 and HTTPS to 443. Other schemes require an explicit port from 1 to 65535.
Handle bracketed IPv6 literals and IDNA hostnames. IP literals skip forward DNS.
Query Team Cymru origin.asn.cymru.com TXT records for globally routable unicast IPv4 addresses. Multi-origin prefixes produce multiple ASN objects.
Deduplicate ASN objects within the expansion and preserve all announced IPv4 subnets. Retrieve the ASN description when available.
Each ip-port object is derived-from the original URL UUID and belongs-to its ASN objects. Each ASN object is related-to the original URL UUID.
Return the original attribute with its UUID and metadata; all newly generated object attributes use to_ids=false.
Missing records for one address family are normal. Partial DNS failures and unavailable IPv4 ASN data are reported in endpoint comments; successful endpoint results are retained.
IPv6 ASN enrichment is outside this module's scope. Non-global and multicast IPv4 addresses retain their endpoints without ASN queries.
This module performs DNS lookups only. The TCP protocol and port are inferred from the URL; no service reachability or protocol negotiation is performed.

output.errors: Invalid requests, URLs or configuration, and failure to resolve any addresses return an error. ASN lookup failures retain endpoint results.

nameserver.description: Optional IPv4 or IPv6 address of a recursive DNS server. Used for both forward resolution and ASN TXT queries. Timeout is two seconds per attempt; lifetime is five seconds per DNS query.

installation: The module is installed at misp_modules/modules/expansion/url_dns.py and is automatically discovered by misp-modules.
Install dnspython and PyMISP in the service's Python environment if missing: python -m pip install dnspython pymisp. Both are already in the repository's minimal dependency set.
Restart the misp-modules service using your normal service manager, then enable url_dns in MISP's Enrichment plugin settings.
Expand an existing URL attribute. Its original UUID must be provided in the request; do not generate a replacement UUID.
No custom MISP object templates or API keys are required. The resolver must be able to retrieve A, AAAA and Team Cymru TXT records.

verification.result: 63 module tests and 6 existing RDAP tests passed with Python 3.12, PyMISP 2.5.34.4 and dnspython 2.9.0.
verification.checks: Strict standard object-template validation, module discovery, Black, isort and flake8 passed.
verification.limitations: DNS responses were mocked. Live DNS and installation into a running MISP instance have not been tested.
